title: ICTT Token Bridge
summary: Bridge an ERC-20 between Avalanche chains
description: Moves an existing ERC-20 from a home chain to a remote chain with Interchain Token Transfer: the audited TokenHome locks it, the TokenRemote mints a 1:1 ERC-20, and ICM carries every transfer.
prompts: Bridge my token from the C-Chain to my L1
Make my ERC-20 usable on another Avalanche chain
Set up a token bridge between my L1 and Fuji

home.description: Chain where the token already lives and is locked

remote.description: Chain that gets the bridged ERC-20; must differ from home

params.name: token
params.description: ERC-20 on the home chain, for example the address erc20-token deployed

params.name: tokenDecimals
params.description: Decimals of the home token, read with decimals()

params.name: remoteName
params.description: Name of the bridged token on the remote chain

params.name: remoteSymbol
params.description: Symbol of the bridged token on the remote chain

params.name: remoteDecimals
params.description: Decimals of the bridged token; keep equal to tokenDecimals unless you need scaling

params.name: teleporterManager
params.description: May pause Teleporter versions and set the minimum version on both contracts

params.name: amount
params.description: Test transfer, in home-token base units

params.name: recipient
params.description: Receives the test transfer on the remote chain

params.name: requiredGasLimit
params.description: Gas for the remote to mint on delivery

prerequisites: The token exists on the home chain and the builder holds at least the test amount
Both chains have a Teleporter registry: registry addresses for Fuji C-Chain, Echo and Dispatch are in the registry; an L1 gets one from l1-quickstart or the console's ICM setup
Native gas on both chains for the signer

contracts.name: ERC20TokenHome
contracts.description: Locks the token on the home chain and sends transfers

contracts.name: ERC20TokenRemote
contracts.description: Bridged ERC-20 on the remote chain

contracts.name: ERC20
contracts.description: Standard ERC-20 ABI, for approving the home token

steps.title: Make sure a relayer serves both chains
Deploy TokenHome on the home chain
Deploy TokenRemote on the remote chain
Register the remote with its home
Wait for the home to learn about the remote
Send the test amount to the remote chain
Wait for the tokens to arrive

checks.description: The recipient holds the bridged tokens

review: TokenHome and TokenRemote are the audited ICTT contracts from contracts/icm-contracts/compiled; do not rewrite them.
tokenHomeDecimals equals the home token's decimals(); a mismatch mis-scales every transfer.
The home chain's registry and the remote chain's registry are each that chain's own TeleporterRegistry.
Transfers wait for registration to be delivered to the home; sending earlier reverts on the home.

frontend.summary: Move a token between the C-Chain and the L1 and back, with both balances side by side.
audience: Holders moving the token to use it on the L1, or bringing it back
journeys: Both balances side by side, one per chain.
Pick a direction with a swap arrow, enter an amount with Max, and send; allowing the token is step 1 of 2 only when needed.
Follow the transfer to arrival, then both balances refresh.
Name the chains and the token in words everywhere ('Bridge 25 USDC to Moon Chain').
flows: Home to remote: approve TokenHome for the amount, then call send(input, amount) on TokenHome with destinationBlockchainID and destinationTokenTransferrerAddress set to the remote.
Remote to home: approve the TokenRemote for the amount on the TokenRemote itself, then call send(input, amount) on it with the home's blockchain ID and TokenHome address.
Read the message id from TokensSent and poll messageReceived on the destination TeleporterMessenger; link the ICM message page on the Builder Hub explorer.
Show balances on both chains side by side and refresh when delivery completes.
